item.text:
Created a dependency-free Rust 2021 project in `/output`. The root entry file is [test11.rs](/output/test11.rs), and the shared code is split across [src/cli.rs](/output/src/cli.rs), [src/geometry.rs](/output/src/geometry.rs), [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), and [src/triangulation.rs](/output/src/triangulation.rs).

It preserves the C++ behavior: `atoi`-style parsing from `std::env::args()`, the same gear polygon generation, a pure-`std` ear-clipping triangulator, and identical output formatting with trailing spaces and no newline.

Verification succeeded with `cargo test`, `cargo build --release`, and `rustc test11.rs -O -o test11_bin`. The compiled binaries are `/output/target/release/test11` and `/output/test11_bin`, and their output matched `/workspace/dataset/test11_executable` byte-for-byte on sampled cases including no arg, `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `11`, `20`, `-1`, `abc`, `12xyz`, `+5`, and `" 7"`.
